role: Research Intern, Theory of Mind in Large Language Models
points: Investigating Theory of Mind capabilities in large language models: whether LLMs can model the beliefs, intentions and mental states of others.
Contributing to research at the intersection of cognitive science, NLP and human-centred AI.

role: Doctoral School Research Collaborator, EEG & Graph Signal Processing
org: Lebanese University Doctoral School of Sciences and Technologie
points: Designed and implemented GBrain, a graph-theoretic EEG pipeline for real-time attention classification; results published at IEEE ICABME.
Self-recorded EEG from ten subjects with a Neuroelectronics headset under controlled attention paradigms, building the acquisition and preprocessing pipeline from scratch.
Developed NeuroClean Pro, an automatic EEG denoising tool using ICA and wavelet filtering.
Investigated functional brain connectivity via spectral analysis and graph-theoretic metrics on multi-channel EEG.
